title: WabbleSpec Delivery Receipt
description: Schema for delivery receipts produced by archive.py. The permanent record of a completed task execution.

task_id.description: Task identifier this delivery receipt closes.

all_waves_passed.description: True when every wave verifier returned PASS.

receipts_aggregated.description: Count or list of receipts folded into this delivery.

version_previous.description: Semver string before this archive bump.

version_new.description: Semver string after this archive bump.

version_bump_reason.description: Highest delta_class found across session receipts.

not_tested_items.description: Count of not_tested items aggregated from all receipts.

not_tested_list.description: Deduplicated not_tested strings from all session receipts.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of what was delivered.
